Trigger: Initial High provisional assessment; material risk; continuity or exception decision
Channel: Verified phone call followed by controlled written record
Alternative channel: In-person briefing or independently verified phone tree
Update frequency: At declaration and each material decision; next update by 10:30 WAT Day 0

Trigger: Containment decision; new evidence; credential or backup control; restoration gate
Channel: Verified phone or approved out-of-band channel
Alternative channel: Direct voice call and controlled offline decision log
Update frequency: At each decision point and when scope changes

Trigger: Confirmed access disruption or approved examination arrangement
Message owner: Academic/Business Service Owner with Communications Coordinator
Channel: Approved learner notice through verified institutional channel
Alternative channel: Verified telephone or approved physical/alternative learning channel
Approver: Academic/Business Service Owner; management for material change
Update frequency: Initial status and before the 11:00 examination decision; update when status changes

Trigger: Assessment availability or submission changes; learner support requirement
Message owner: Business Continuity Coordinator / Academic Service Owner
Channel: Verified phone briefing and approved staff notice
Alternative channel: Direct phone calls or controlled staff briefing
Update frequency: At initial decision, before examination start and at material change

Trigger: Need for provider records, identity support, backup validation or recovery assistance
Message owner: IT Operations Lead with Security Analyst
Channel: Approved provider portal or verified support contact
Alternative channel: Verified telephone contact and controlled case record
Approver: Senior Management for engagement and information sharing
Update frequency: At request, provider response and material finding

Trigger: Potential personal-data implication or reporting-obligation question
Channel: Verified phone and restricted fact pack
Alternative channel: Direct verified call; no sensitive forensic detail over unverified email
Approver: Senior Management for formal advice or notification decision
Update frequency: At initial uncertainty and whenever facts change materially

Trigger: Account or endpoint protection; operational instructions; fact-bounded safety notice
Message owner: Communications Coordinator with Incident Response Lead
Channel: Verified telephone call and approved staff notice
Alternative channel: Direct phone call or controlled briefing
Approver: Incident Response Lead; Privacy Adviser if personal information is included
Update frequency: Initial instruction and when user action changes

Trigger: External query or public rumour requiring approved response
Channel: Approved statement through authorised public channel
Alternative channel: Verified telephone response or holding statement
Update frequency: Only when approved; reassess when public information changes
